description: This file defines the AggregatedCachePressureMonitor class, which implements monitoring and aggregation of cache pressure metrics in the Orleans streaming infrastructure, specifically for Event Hubs. It manages a collection of ICachePressureMonitor instances, records cache pressure contributions, and determines overall pressure status.

classes.name: AggregatedCachePressureMonitor
classes.description: A class that aggregates multiple cache pressure monitors to assess overall cache pressure status within Orleans streaming infrastructure for Event Hubs.

methods.name: AggregatedCachePressureMonitor
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the monitor with a logger and optional cache monitor.

methods.name: RecordCachePressureContribution
methods.description: Records a cache pressure contribution across all monitors.

methods.name: AddCachePressureMonitor
methods.description: Adds a new cache pressure monitor to the aggregation.

methods.name: IsUnderPressure
methods.description: Checks if any monitor reports pressure and updates the monitor state accordingly.
